mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the central collection, analysis, and dissemination of data reported under the Bank Secrecy Act."
FinCEN is responsible for the central collection, analysis, and dissemination of data reported under the Bank Secrecy Act.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a general population survey designed to discover the extent, nature and consequences of criminal victimization."
The National Crime Victimization Survey (NCVS) is a general population survey designed to discover the extent, nature and consequences of criminal victimization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the concept of victim facilitation."
Similar to victim precipitation is the concept of victim facilitation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a science; victimologists use the scientific method to answer questions about victims."
Victimology is a science; victimologists use the scientific method to answer questions about victims.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the extent to which a victim is responsible for his or her own victimization."
Victim precipitation is defined as the extent to which a victim is responsible for his or her own victimization.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the major providers of crime data and the ways in which the different agencies in the country use their crime data differs considerably."
Law enforcement agencies are one of the major providers of crime data and the ways in which the different agencies in the country use their crime data differs considerably.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used at numerous levels of analysis."
Crime data are used at numerous levels of analysis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the perceived likelihood that a person feels that he or she will become a crime victim."
Perceived risk is the perceived likelihood that a person feels that he or she will become a crime victim.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interesting hybrid in that it both employs and eschews a rigid hierarchical rule."
The NCVS is an interesting hybrid in that it both employs and eschews a rigid hierarchical rule.
